pages.name: Shiny Pile
pages.description: A carved wooden bird lies among the feathers. The beating of wings comes from above.

options.description: Leave a few pretty stones in exchange

pages.name: Angry Owners
pages.description: The ravens raise an uproar, and you have to drop the figurine.

pages.name: Fair Exchange
pages.description: The ravens carefully count the shiny stones and allow you to take the carved figurine.

pages.name: Untouched Cache
pages.description: You move away from the niche without disturbing its owners.
